description: Burgundy floor-length noble gown with gold woven neckline, sleeve and front borders, a low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and a narrow embroidered belt. A cream underlayer and fine cream embroidered wrap draped along the arms complete the layered outfit. Small gold drop earrings, a delicate pendant and closed embroidered shoes are visible. Opaque fabric covers bust, abdomen and pelvis; no headgear, armor or weapons.
